summary: The proof correctly establishes the irrationality of sqrt(2) via the standard infinite descent argument. All logical steps are valid: the assumption of rationality leads to a representation sqrt(2) = p/q in lowest terms; squaring yields p² = 2q², implying p is even; substituting p = 2r yields q² = 2r², implying q is even; this contradicts the coprimality of p and q. The algebraic manipulations and parity arguments are rigorously justified. No external citations are used.
